transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get this coordination huddle going. We've got Alpha and Bravo recertification next week, and two available training blocks: Monday 0800-1200 and Tuesday 1300-1700. We need to sort out who's going in which block and get Alpha's evaluator nailed down for the schedule. Bravo's evaluator will be confirmed through battalion training after this huddle, so we don't need to worry about that today. Who's got input on Alpha's evaluator and how we should split the cohorts across these two blocks?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Capt. Morgan, I checked the training database this morning. The only evaluator currently authorized for the Alpha cohort is Sgt. Lewis, and he's available Monday 0800-1200. The evaluator roster hasn't been attached to the weekly schedule yet, but I can confirm his authorization is current.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Capt. Morgan, I need to flag a scheduling conflict. I confirmed the bay booking today — Bravo's assigned vehicles are booked for preventive maintenance Monday afternoon and Tuesday morning. That means Bravo can only train during the Tuesday 1300-1700 block, after motor pool release. The maintenance calendar hasn't been cross-referenced with the training schedule yet, so this is the first time it's coming up. Bottom line: Bravo needs Tuesday 1300-1700, which leaves Monday 0800-1200 for Alpha.
transcript.speaker: A3
